_about: Starred (*[) blocks inside general CPC units, checked by hand against the text (session 5, CPC as on 10 Jan 2026). The footnote verb alone can't decide the direction: O.V r.1 and O.VIII r.1 both say 'Subs. ... for the Proviso', but O.V r.1's starred proviso is the general 90-day text (its commercial replacement isn't printed) while O.VIII r.1's is the commercial 120-day text. kind: commercial_only = applies only to commercial disputes of a specified value (Commercial Courts Act, 2015, as amended by Act 4 of 2016); not_for_commercial = general law that does not apply to those disputes; split_rules = a starred unit holding several rules that are not in the contents list. segment.py stops with an error if it meets a starred block that is not listed here.
